summary_paragraph: Mr. Johnson was admitted for observation following an ERCP with stent placement performed to evaluate biliary ductal dilatation and possible cholangiocarcinoma. He presented with jaundice, weight loss, and a history of nausea. Post-procedure, his liver function tests initially rose but subsequently trended downward, allowing for conservative management. He remained asymptomatic, tolerated a regular diet, and showed clinical improvement. A small lung nodule was noted on CT, prompting recommendation for follow-up imaging. He was discharged home on a 14-day course of ciprofloxacin with instructions to monitor for fever, worsening abdominal symptoms, or increased jaundice, and advised that the ERCP team would contact him regarding further interventions if needed.
